modifications: Mapped all 152 public graph structures: 123 direct, 4 compound, and 25 contextual.
Selected exact source elements from the verified BodyParts3D 4.0 IS-A and PART-OF archives.
Combined direct meshes into eight region GLBs and packaged compound structures as lazy region supplements.
Applied a reviewed 18% vertex-removal web LOD to shoulder meshes so base plus first supplement stays inside the cumulative region budget.
Converted Z-up millimetres to Y-up metres, indexed duplicate vertices, and added application grouping and category materials.
Context entries reference related source-backed meshes only; no missing joint, ligament, muscle, or tendon geometry was inferred.

coverage.reviewReason: The official zone of deltoid representation resolves all bilateral clavicular, acromial, and spinal deltoid element meshes.
The official short-head and long-head representations supply the complete bilateral component set for biceps brachii.
The official flexor digitorum superficialis and profundus representations supply the bilateral primary finger-flexor component meshes; they remain visual components rather than target identity.
The official zone of quadriceps femoris representation resolves the complete bilateral rectus femoris and three vastus element-mesh groups.
